examples.input: Write a 5-email welcome sequence for a B2B SaaS product (CRM for small businesses). Trigger: new free trial signup. Goal: activate the user and convert to paid plan ($49/month). The trial is 14 days.

sequence_overview.goal: Activate user (import contacts, send first email) within 3 days, convert to paid within 14 days

emails.name: Email 1: The Warm Welcome
emails.subject: Your CRM is ready — let's get set up
emails.alt_subject: Welcome! Here's your quickest path to value
emails.preview_text: 3 steps to import your contacts (takes 2 minutes)
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Welcome to [Product]! You just made life a lot easier for yourself.

Here's what I'd do first if I were starting a 14-day trial (and I wanted to see results fast):

**Step 1: Import your contacts** (2 min)
Drag and drop a CSV, or connect Gmail/Outlook and we'll pull them in automatically.
→ [Import contacts now]

**Step 2: Send your first follow-up** (1 min)
Pick a contact you've been meaning to follow up with. Use one of our templates or write your own.

**Step 3: See the magic** ✨
Watch [Product] automatically log the conversation, set a reminder, and suggest your next step.

That's it. Three steps, five minutes, and you'll see why 2,000+ small businesses use [Product] every day.

[Import my contacts →]

Questions? Just reply to this email — I'm a real person and I read every reply.

Cheers,
[Name], Head of Customer Success
dynamic_elements: Conditional: show Gmail import if email is @gmail.com, Outlook if @outlook.com

emails.name: Email 2: The Quick Win
emails.delay: 24 hours after signup (skip if user already imported contacts)
emails.subject: Most teams see this in the first week
emails.preview_text: How [Customer] booked 3 meetings from one follow-up sequence
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Day 2 of your trial. Here's what typically happens this week:

**Teams that import contacts on Day 1** close their first deal 40% faster during the trial.

Here's why: [Product] spots the leads you haven't followed up with. It shows you who opened your emails, who visited your site, and who's ready to hear from you.

🎯 **[Customer Name], a 3-person consulting firm**, imported their contacts on Monday. By Friday, they'd booked 3 new meetings from follow-ups [Product] suggested — leads they'd completely forgotten about.

{{#if contacts_imported}}
You've already imported contacts — great! Try sending your first follow-up sequence.
[Create a follow-up sequence →]
{{else}}
You haven't imported contacts yet. It takes 2 minutes:
[Import contacts now →]
{{/if}}

Cheers,
[Name]

emails.name: Email 3: The Feature Spotlight
emails.subject: This feature saves our users 5 hrs/week
emails.preview_text: Automatic email logging — no more manual CRM updates
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick question: how much time do you spend updating your CRM after every call and email?

For most small business owners, it's 5-7 hours per week. Some just... stop updating it entirely.

[Product] fixes this. Every email, every call, every meeting — automatically logged to the right contact. No copying. No typing. No forgetting.

[See how automatic logging works (45-sec video) →]

You're on day 4 of your trial. This is usually the feature that makes people say "okay, I need this."

Cheers,
[Name]

emails.name: Email 4: The Social Proof
emails.subject: Why {{similar_company}} switched to us
emails.preview_text: Real story from a team your size
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I wanted to share a story from a team a lot like yours.

{{similar_company_testimonial}}

"We tried HubSpot (too complex), Pipedrive (too salesy), and spreadsheets (too messy). [Product] was the first CRM our whole team actually used. Setup took an afternoon, not a quarter."
— {{testimonial_author}}, {{role}}

You have {{days_remaining}} days left in your trial. If you've been on the fence, this might help:

✅ No long-term contracts — cancel anytime
✅ We migrate your data for free if you're switching from another CRM
✅ Support response time: under 2 hours, every time

[Upgrade to Pro — $49/month →]

Cheers,
[Name]

emails.name: Email 5: The Last Chance
emails.subject: Your trial ends in 2 days
emails.preview_text: Everything you've built is saved — here's how to keep it
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your free trial ends in 2 days.

Here's what you've built so far:
• {{contacts_count}} contacts imported
• {{emails_sent}} follow-ups sent
• {{activities_logged}} activities automatically logged

If you upgrade, everything stays exactly as it is. If your trial expires, your data is safe for 30 days — but you'll lose access to the dashboard, automations, and email tracking.

**Upgrade now and lock in $49/month** (our price increases to $59 for new signups next quarter).

[Keep my account active →]

Not ready? No hard feelings. Reply and tell me what's holding you back — I'd genuinely like to know.

Cheers,
[Name]

automation_rules.branch_logic: If user has NOT imported contacts by Day 3, send an additional nudge email before Email 3. If user is highly active (logged in 5+ times), skip Email 2 and send Email 3 early.
automation_rules.suppression: Do not send to users who have opened a support ticket in the last 24 hours (they may be frustrated — let support resolve first)

examples.input: Write a 3-email cart abandonment sequence for an e-commerce store selling premium headphones ($150-$400). Average cart value is $280.

sequence_overview.trigger: Cart abandoned for 1 hour with items still in cart
sequence_overview.notes: At $280 average cart value, recovering even 30 carts/month = $8,400 in recovered revenue

emails.name: Email 1: The Gentle Reminder
emails.subject: Still thinking about the {{product_name}}?
emails.preview_text: Your cart is saved — finish your order anytime
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Looks like you left something behind:

[PRODUCT IMAGE]
**{{product_name}}** — {{product_price}}
{{product_short_description}}

⭐ {{product_rating}}/5 from {{review_count}} reviews

Your cart is saved and ready when you are.

[Complete my order →]

**Free shipping** on orders over $199
**30-day returns** — no questions asked

Need help deciding? Our audio experts are here: [Chat with us]
emails.notes: No discount in email 1 — many customers just got distracted. Don't train them to expect discounts.

emails.name: Email 2: The Social Proof
emails.subject: Here's what {{product_name}} owners say
emails.preview_text: "Best headphones I've ever owned" — verified buyer
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Still considering the {{product_name}}? Here's what other customers said after they pulled the trigger:

💬 "The noise cancellation changed my work-from-home setup completely. Worth every penny." — Sarah M., verified buyer

💬 "I compared these to Sony and Bose before buying. No contest — the soundstage is incredible." — James K., verified buyer

💬 "Bought them for flights. Now I wear them everywhere." — Alex R., verified buyer

[Product IMAGE + rating stars]
**{{product_name}}** — {{product_price}}

[Complete my order →]

🔒 Secure checkout | 📦 Free shipping | 🔄 30-day returns

emails.name: Email 3: The Incentive
emails.subject: 10% off your {{product_name}} — today only
emails.preview_text: Your exclusive offer expires at midnight
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Last nudge — promise.

Your **{{product_name}}** is still in your cart, and I'd hate for you to miss out. Here's a little incentive:

**Use code COMEBACK10 for 10% off your order.**

[PRODUCT IMAGE]
~~{{product_price}}~~ → **{{discounted_price}}**
You save: **{{savings_amount}}**

⏰ This code expires at midnight tonight.

[Claim my 10% off →]

If you've decided these aren't right for you, no worries at all. But if you've been going back and forth — this is your sign.

Cheers,
The [Brand] Team
emails.notes: Only offer discount in email 3 (72 hours later). If they buy from email 1 or 2, you've saved 10% margin. Set the coupon to expire in 24 hours for real urgency.

examples.input: Create a re-engagement sequence for subscribers who haven't opened an email in 90 days. Our list has 15,000 inactive subscribers. We're a fitness app with a $12/month subscription.

sequence_overview.goal: Re-engage 15-20% of dormant subscribers. Remove the rest to improve deliverability.
sequence_overview.deliverability_impact: Cleaning 12,000 dead subscribers will likely improve overall open rates by 5-8 percentage points

emails.name: Email 1: The 'We Miss You'
emails.subject: We haven't seen you in a while 👋
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

It's been 90 days since you last opened one of our emails. We're not going to pretend that doesn't sting a little. 😅

A lot has changed since you've been away:

🆕 New workout programs: HIIT, Yoga, Strength — 50+ new classes
🆕 AI-powered plans that adapt to your schedule
🆕 Community challenges with real prizes

Want to come back and check it out?

[Reactivate my account — free for 7 days →]

If you'd rather not hear from us anymore, we understand. You can [unsubscribe here] — no hard feelings.

Keep moving,
The [App] Team

emails.name: Email 2: The Incentive
emails.subject: Come back for 50% off your first month
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We'd love to have you back. Here's a reason to give us another shot:

**50% off your first month back — just $6.**

[Restart for $6 →]

Offer expires in 5 days.

emails.name: Email 3: The Goodbye
emails.subject: Last email from us (unless you say stay)
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

This is our last email. We don't want to fill your inbox if you're not interested — that's not cool for either of us.

**Click below if you want to keep hearing from us:**

[Yes, keep me subscribed →]

If we don't hear from you, we'll remove you from our list in 5 days. Your account and data will stay safe if you ever want to come back.

No hard feelings. Seriously. 💪

The [App] Team

post_sequence_rules.re_engaged: Subscribers who open or click any email → move to 'Re-activated' segment, send a 'Welcome Back' email with personalized workout recommendation
post_sequence_rules.still_inactive: Subscribers who don't engage with any of the 3 emails → unsubscribe from marketing emails after 5-day grace period. Keep in CRM for transactional emails only.
post_sequence_rules.impact: Expected outcome: re-engage ~2,250 subscribers (15%), clean ~12,750 from active list. Deliverability should improve significantly within 2-4 weeks.
